item.title: Olá. Hello. こんにちは.
item.description: Bio I’m João Victor, a software engineer at Google. I have a Computer Science degree from Universidade Federal de São Carlos. Most of my recent work has been creating new Supervision APIs in the Android Open Source Project. I have experience working on GMS Core, creating back-end services, some light UI work, and helping build a new version of Family Link (Flutter). The languages I’m more comfortable with are Kotlin, Java, TS/JS, C/C++, Rust, Python, and Dart.
